segments.name: Language Learning
segments.description: Offers freemium language, math, music and chess courses plus English proficiency testing to learners worldwide, largely free of charge.
segments.evidence: The Company operates as a single operating segment and derives revenues from customers through time-based subscriptions, in-app advertising placement by third parties, the Duolingo English Test, and In-App Purchases.

revenueModel.text: Learners pay for subscriptions and in-app purchases, advertisers pay for in-app advertising, and test takers pay for the Duolingo English Test.
revenueModel.evidence: Learners who use Duolingo for free see an ad at the end of each lesson, whereas learners who purchase one of our paid subscriptions enjoy an ad-free experience and access to additional features.
